goals: Make and answer simple phone calls: greeting, asking for someone, taking or leaving a message.
Make polite requests with Can I...? and Could you...?
Ask for help when she can't understand on the phone (Could you speak more slowly? / Sorry, I can't hear you.).
Link words smoothly in phone chunks (hold on, pick up, can I, take a message).

easy: Do you use LINE every day?
Do you like talking on the phone?
Who do you call the most?
medium: Do you like calling or sending messages more? Why?
How often do you video call your family?
What do you do when an unknown number calls you?
hard: Why are phone calls in English harder than talking face to face?
Tell me about a funny or difficult phone call you had.
Do people send too many messages these days? What do you think?

key_phrases.en: Sorry, she's not here right now.
Could you ask her to call me back?

grammar.point_en: Polite requests: Can I...? / Could you...?
grammar.point_zh: 禮貌請求：Can I…?（我可以…嗎？）／Could you…?（可以請你…嗎？）
grammar.explain_zh: 請對方幫忙時，英文常用 Could you + 原形動詞？，比 Can you 更客氣。問自己能不能做某事時用 Can I…? 或 Could I…?。中文常直接說「說慢一點」，但英文直接用命令句聽起來很兇，改成 Could you…, please? 就禮貌多了。

examples.en: Can I speak to Ms. Chen, please?
Could you call me back later?
examples.zh: 可以請你晚點回我電話嗎？

common_mistake.wrong: Hello, I am Mei. Can I speak to Mr. Lin?
common_mistake.right: Hello, this is Mei. Can I speak to Mr. Lin?
common_mistake.why_zh: 講電話介紹自己用 This is ___，不說 I am ___。

sound_focus.sentence: She can't pick up right now. Can I take a message?

mini_lesson: Step 1 (5 min): Warm-up. Ask 2-3 warm-up questions about LINE and phone habits. Show your own phone and point out: missed call, voice message, voicemail, battery.

Step 2 (7 min): Phone script. Write a basic call on the board: 'Hello, this is ___.' → 'Can I speak to ___?' → 'Hold on, please.' / 'Sorry, she's not here. Can I take a message?' Read it together, then erase words one at a time while she repeats from memory.

Step 3 (7 min): Grammar. Contrast 'Speak slowly.' (sounds rude) with 'Could you speak more slowly, please?' Give her 5 commands (say it again, spell it, call me back, wait, text me) and she turns each into a 'Could you...?' request.

Step 4 (6 min): Sound focus (linking). Show how a final consonant joins the next vowel: pick‿up = pih-KUP, hold‿on = hohl-DAHN, can‿I = kuh-nye, take‿a = TAY-kuh. Practice 'She can't pick up right now. Can I take a message?' slowly, then at natural speed.
Step 5 (5 min): Back-to-back listening. Sit back to back (no lip-reading, like a real call). Say a name and a phone number; she writes it down and reads it back: 'So that's 0912-345-678?'

roleplays.title: Calling an office
roleplays.setup_zh: 她打電話到朋友的公司找人，對方不在，請接電話的人幫忙留言。

lines.en: Hello, Sunshine Travel. How can I help you?
Hello, this is ___. Can I speak to Ms. Wang, please?
lines.zh: 你好，我是 ___。請問王小姐在嗎？

lines.en: Sorry, she's not here right now. Can I take a message?
Yes, please. Could you ask her to call me back?
lines.zh: 好的，可以請她回我電話嗎？

lines.en: Sure. What's your phone number?
Let me check. Zero nine one two... Is that right?
Yes, that's right. Thank you so much.
You're welcome. Have a nice day!
You too. Bye!

roleplays.title: Changing a reservation by phone
roleplays.setup_zh: 她打電話到餐廳更改訂位。店員講很快，電話還有雜音，她要請對方說慢一點、重複，並確認細節。
roleplays.teacher_role: Restaurant staff who talks fast on a bad line

lines.en: Good-afternoon-Golden-Garden-how-can-I-help-you?
Hi. Sorry, could you speak more slowly, please?
lines.zh: 你好。不好意思，可以說慢一點嗎？

lines.en: Of course. Golden Garden. How can I help you?
I have a reservation for Friday. Can I change it to Saturday?
lines.zh: 我星期五有訂位，可以改到星期六嗎？

lines.en: Sure. What's the name on the reservation?
It's under ___. That's ___ (spell your name).
Thank you. And for how... [noise] ...people?
Sorry, I can't hear you. Could you say that again?
lines.zh: 抱歉，我聽不到，可以再說一次嗎？

lines.en: How many people?
Four people, at seven o'clock, please.
OK, Saturday at seven for four. We'll send you a text message to confirm.
Great. Thank you! Bye.

teacher_twists: Say Saturday at seven is full, so she has to ask 'Could I come at eight instead?'
Read her phone number back with one wrong digit so she has to correct you ('No, it's zero nine one...').
Pretend the line drops ('Hello? Hello?') so she has to say 'Sorry, I can't hear you. I'll call you back.'

homework_zh: 用 LINE 傳 3 則英文訊息給老師（例如 Could you send me the homework?），練習 Can I / Could you。
錄一則 20 秒的英文語音留言：說你是誰、要找誰、請對方回電，並留下電話號碼。
每天用英文唸兩次自己的手機號碼，並練習 hold on、pick up、can I 的連音。
